articles.title: Post your questions for Miranda Richardson
articles.summary: She has lit up screens large and small playing Ruth Ellis, Rita Skeeter, Barbara Castle and the hilarious Queenie in Blackadder. Alternatively, you could ask about birds of prey, orangutans or playing the cello.
body: Judging by the size of her awards cupboard, Miranda Richardson has had quite the career. She won a Bafta for the 1992 psychological drama Damage, opposite Jeremy Irons, and Golden Globes for the 1991 historical drama Enchanted April and the 1994 Nazi thriller Fatherland, and was Oscar-nominated for both Damage and the 1994 historical drama Tom & Viv. Her other notable performances include IRA member Jude in The Crying Game, Ruth Ellis in Dance With a Stranger and Lady Van Tassel in Sleepy Hollow.

She’s pretty handy at comedy, too – and probably just as familiar for playing acid-tongued Daily Prophet journalist Rita Skeeter in Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire, the murderous chicken-farm owner Mrs Tweedy in Chicken Run and, of course, the gloriously unhinged Queenie in Blackadder II: “I may have the body of a weak and feeble woman, but I have the heart and stomach of a concrete elephant.”

articles.title: Heart of the Beast review – Brad Pitt survivalist dogmance serves up wilderness with side of cheese
articles.summary: Pitt and loyal hound Odin get stuck in remote Alaska in this serviceable adventure with hints of Jack London and Marley & Me. One man and his dog have an amazing adventure in this survivalist drama starring Brad Pitt, from screenwriter Cameron Alexander and director David Ayer, for which the first…
body: Pitt, who last worked with Ayer on the second world war action thriller Fury, plays a US military special forces veteran called Belmont, tough, self-reliant and laconically good-humoured in the classic Pitt manner, now spending his retirement roaming the breathtaking remote landscape of Alaska in his seaplane. He is accompanied by his beloved service dog Odin, or Odey (played by four different German shepherds), who saw action with Belmont in various fuzzily imagined flashback combat sequences. Odin took retirement with Belmont and is now his best and only pal. Whether or not Belmont ever had a human partner is never revealed.

articles.title: Lionel Richie Undergoes Heart Procedure, ‘Will Be Back on Stage Soon’ After Canceling Next Three Shows
articles.summary: Lionel Richie will miss at least a few concert dates after being hospitalized this week and undergoing a procedure to treat atrial fibrillation, the singer’s rep says. “Lionel underwent a common procedure for Atrial fibrillation (AFib),” Richie’s representative said in a statement given to Variety.
body: The next three dates on the tour Richie has been on with Earth, Wind & Fire have been canceled. Those dates were scheduled for Saturday night in San Francisco, Sept. 30 in Chicago and Oct. 2 in Columbus, Ohio. The next shows on Richie’s concert calendar, a three-night stand at Las Vegas’ Encore Theater beginning Oct. 14, are still on, as of this writing.

The Mayo Clinic describes the common AFib procedure as “treatment for an irregular and often very fast heartbeat… The treatment uses heat energy, cold energy or high-energy electric pulses to create tiny scars in an area of the heart. The signals that tell the heart to beat can’t pass through scar tissue. So the treatment helps block faulty signals that cause AFib.”
Richie’s health has been in the news lately with some other canceled dates and hospitalizations, although he has seemingly quickly bounced back in each instance.

On June 24, on the first night of the joint tour with EWF, the singer brought a show in Minneapolis to an early halt after mentioning feeling dizzy, and he subsequently canceled two dates, but he was back on stage for the tour’s June 30 stop, and told the crowd not to worry.

articles.title: How NBCUniversal Television Thrives on Collaborative Energy Between Studios and Platforms: ‘We Cheer Each Other On’
articles.summary: From Donna Langley to Pearlena Igbokwe to Frances Berwick to Liz Jenkins, female executives largely run the show at NBCUniversal. In television, Igbokwe’s core team is tasked with overseeing NBCU’s television studio imprints — Universal Television, Universal Global Television and Universal…
body: Across the Universal-verse, the environment is unusually collegial and collaborative in Springborn’s experience because they’re all striving for the same thing: to make great television.

“When you create a creative environment, it helps everyone feel like they’re part of everything you’re trying to do. That makes a huge difference, and it is a distinguishing factor for Universal,” Springborn says. “Having people who are smarter than you in a lot of different areas and having people around you who want to succeed — that makes a huge difference.”

The strong work culture instilled by Igbokwe in her role as chairman of Universal Television Studios, NBC Entertainment and Scripted helps her teams channel their energy in the right direction, executives say.

“We support each other. We cheer each other on,” says Underhill, whose division is home to a broad range of shows, from brawny Dick Wolf procedurals to HBO Max’s Emmy juggernaut “Hacks” to Reba McEntire’s NBC sitcom “Happy’s Place.”

articles.title: Brigitte Bardot’s personal items sell for nearly €1m at auction in Paris
articles.summary: Dog collars, guitars and self-portraits among 285 objects, with money going to her animal welfare foundation and son. An auction of the French film star turned animal rights activist Brigitte Bardot’s personal items has fetched nearly €1m (£858,000, US$1.15m, A$1.61m) in Paris, almost 20 times the…
body: A total of 285 objects were auctioned, ranging from straw hats, sunglasses and nightgowns to tableware and furniture from Bardot’s homes in Paris and Saint-Tropez, Agence France-Presse (AFP) reported.

Bardot, who died in December aged 91, retired from acting in the 1970s and became an outspoken campaigner for animal rights. She also became increasingly active politically on the far right, alienating some fans in her later life with her hardline views on immigration. Bardot was convicted five times for hate speech, particularly about Muslims, and up until her death she expressed her pleasure at the rising share of the vote gained by the anti-immigration National Rally party.
The proceeds from the auction will go to her animal welfare foundation and to Nicolas-Jacques Charrier, her only child.

Founded by the actor in 1986, the Brigitte Bardot Foundation says it has taken in 13,000 animals through four shelters and 150 partner facilities, supports 350 groups in France and operates in 70 countries.

articles.title: Babystar review – a new arrival upends camera-ready life in disturbing family influencer satire
articles.summary: Every ethical issue surrounding parents vlogging their kids’ childhoods for money is raised in Joscha Bongard’s debut, but it releases the dysfunctional tension too easily. When teenager Luca (Maja Bons) wants to watch the film of her birth, she finds it on YouTube.
body: Sixteen-year-old Luca is the only child of Stella (Bea Brocks) and Chris (Liliom Lewald), social media stars who make viral videos of their perfect-looking family life for their 4 million followers. They live in a beautiful, sterile minimalist home in the countryside, and we often watch them through CCTV cameras fitted in every room. Shrewdly, first time film-maker Joscha Bongard doesn’t portray Stella and Chris as monsters; they love their daughter Luca, who they affectionately call Nunki. But fundamentally they do their best parenting in front of the camera, all bright smiles and proud affectionate glances.

articles.title: Autopsy shows Hayden Panettiere died from a drug overdose
articles.summary: The death of the child star - who had fentanyl, Xanax, a muscle relaxant and antipsychotic medication in her system - was ruled an accident.
body: Child star Hayden Panettiere died from the toxic effects of fentanyl, Xanax and several other drugs in her system, according to an autopsy completed by the Greenville County Coroner's Office in South Carolina.
The coroner's office said Panettiere's death was an accident and that no signs of trauma were discovered that would have contributed to her death.
Panettiere died last month at the age of 36 after she was found unresponsive at a South Carolina residence.
The star of US TV shows Heroes and Nashville had spoken openly about her struggles with substance abuse.

articles.title: Sir Sean Connery's family plans new filmmaking centre in Edinburgh
articles.summary: It will be named after the James Bond actor, who worked as a milkman in the Scottish capital before becoming a Hollywood star.
body: The family of Sir Sean Connery has announced plans for a new filmmaking centre in Edinburgh.
His children say they want it to provide training for the next generation of Scotland's film and TV talent and help them build lasting careers.

They said their father "understood that while talent may be distributed equally, opportunity is not, and that those who demonstrate determination and endeavour should have the chance to fulfill their potential".
They have unveiled plans to open the NFTS Sean Connery Institute in Edinburgh city centre within the next 18 months.

articles.title: As a ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Pro, Rylee Arnold Is Making Her Mark
articles.summary: Ahead of Viral Hits Night, Rylee chats with The Hollywood Reporter about her journey from ‘Juniors’ to the main show, and what she’s learned in her last four years as a ‘DWTS’ pro.
body: Rylee Arnold was destined to become a Dancing With the Stars professional dancer. Having been on the cast for four years now, she’s learned a lot about herself.

Rylee’s older sister, Lindsay Arnold, appeared on DWTS as a pro for 11 seasons, winning season 25 with Jordan Fisher in 2017. One year later, Rylee joined the show’s family alongside her sibling on Dancing With the Stars: Juniors, the spinoff that spotlighted younger stars and dancers.

“I feel like looking back at that time, I was a completely different person,” she says. “But I also love that Rylee so much, because I feel like she went through a lot and she learned a lot about herself. And because of that, I’m here now.”

Fast forward a few years, and Rylee has undoubtedly contributed to the show’s resurgence, by becoming the first pro to utilize social media to garner fan attention and also entice a younger audience to watch. And that intrigue hasn’t slowed down; if anything, it’s rising as each new episode comes out, and as the DWTS pros and celebrities post new pieces of content, inviting audiences into their world.
